title: Sunset with Bare Necessities
hosts: Gabe Clouston, Vinny Lunar, Sam Z

rows.title: País Tropical
notes: “That one just there was a cover of País Tropical by Wilson Simonal.”
Written by Jorge Ben; Simonal's 1968 recording was actually released before Ben's own, so the presenter's framing as a Simonal 'cover' tracks the real history.

rows.title: No Me Arrepiento De Este Amor
Mi Novia Es Caracas
notes: “It's the Billos Caracas Boys. This is, I would say, probably more on the Bolero tip. It's off the album called En Homenaje a Caracas. And this is Mi Novia es Caracas.”
Real track on the Venezuelan orchestra's compilation album En Homenaje a Caracas, alongside 'Canto a Caracas' and 'Caracas Vieja' (YouTube link is for the album's 'Canto a Caracas', same release).

rows.artist: José Luis Cortés y NG la Banda
rows.title: Murakamis Mambo
Simb
notes: “This is a track by the great band Lemzo Jamano. This is Sim on FBi Radio 94.5.”
1990s track by Senegalese mbalax/'marimbalax' group Lemzo Diamono, led by Lamine Faye; presenter's 'Lemzo Jamano'/'Sim' are mishearings of the real name and title.

rows.title: Do A Do
notes: “That was Dora Morellimbom of her new album, Live in Rio, Do A Do.”
Brazilian artist's track (with Tom Veloso), closing song on her Vento de Beirada EP (Mr Bongo); no 'Live in Rio' album by her could be found, so that album title is likely an ASR mishearing.
